pearProfiles.scope: Actual indexed six lower-bulb/upper-neck pear silhouettes; not fruit biology, ripeness, growth, picking or edibility

curvedSections.scope: Finite saved wood cross-sections and adjacent centerline turns; no continuous-curvature or wind/load claim

gaps.scope: Four selected finite rays checked against both wood frame and all saved parts separately; leaves/pears elsewhere may intentionally occupy other fan cells

actualRootCapNormals.scope: Every indexed vertex of each true flat bottom cap; bevel shading seams are separate, not flatShading material or a physical support guarantee

diagnosticFloor.scope: 15 finite actual root-pad/diagnostic-plane triangle pairs. Current Scene placement is a separate finite probe; no full contact area or load/stability/physics proof.

audit.scope: One finite saved low-fan tree assembly; actual triangles/material witnesses only. No all-world, all-angle/pixel, real horticulture or physical/ordinary gameplay guarantee.

geometryIdentity.method: SHA256 of explicit typed position/index layout plus exact underlying bytes. Distinct from JSON numeric serialization and mathematical congruence.

cameras.scope: 135 finite whole-object camera poses only; not continuous visibility, every pixel, every partial interior, physical-device or collision safety

probe.contactSupportKind: five actual bottom-triangle samples on each of three authored broad flat root pads

originalSpriteEnvelopeClearance.method: sphere enclosing all four full raw Sprite quad corners from actual world scale/center; sphere-to-conservative-3D-pose-envelope distance; includes faint/transparent corners without cropping

probe.buildingProxyScope: actual current place-group mesh AABBs only; not full building geometry or transparent original-art fixture volume clearance

meadowInstances.scope: every actual current meadow instance geometry AABB transformed by its actual instance and world matrix, expanded .018 in all axes; current finite matrices and authored animation allowance, no all-frame proof

shoreline.method: every actual dry-land boundary segment against entire pear-tree XZ AABB

probe.limits: one fixed authored standalone pear-tree pose at one synthetic current-default-world site;15 finite root-pad-bottom/floor triangle pairs on three actual authored root pads,63 finite walkability samples and conservative current road, original-card, meadow, shore and building-proxy envelope clearances. These finite witnesses do not verify full root-pad surface contact, planting/training/pruning/growth/fruit collection, support stability, load, physical behavior, body fit, whole-world placement or all-camera visibility

placement.Node_DOM_limitation: Actual current local Scene geometry and finite helper probes; Node does not load image assets as a browser. Browser originalArtready/world baseline remains a later actual native gate.
